text: Larkspur Sparkmane is a tauren mage located in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

Lathos Sunband is a blood elf located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span. While initially wary of his partner Rannan Korren, Lathos eventually warmed up to him and sacrificed his life to save him. He's buried near Camp Nowhere.
Leanine Starborn is a high elf wizard and priestess. She is friends of the tauren Maruff Grandhorn, and Alastair Bentstaff is her nemesis.
Leah Drewry is a human tailoring vendor found in Highbank of the Twilight Highlands.

Leagrem was a human from Lordaeron who fought during the Third War. His last battle was in Hearthglen alongside Arthas against the Scourge. His leg was broken during a charge, but still he continued to fight to the bitter end. He wrote a final letter to his friend, Reuben.
Leah Kranz is a human found strolling around Stormshield selling her baked goods.
Lazrek is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Lea Stonepaw is a night elf located at the Tel'Andu Barrow Den in the Dreamgrove. She is the leader of the Druids of the Claw.
Laura Stern is a human located in the Hall of Shadows. She is the recruiter for Ravenholdt Assassins.
Laurette Royston is a human located in Staghelm Point in Silithus: The Wound.
Layla Evenkeel is a human located at the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She runs an engineering shop named Evenkeel's Engineered Marvels.
Leaping Giants is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Scales of the Earth and Wall of Steel traits.
Lea Martinel is a human located at Eckhart Lodge in Stormsong Valley.
Leanne Rasmussen is a human located at the Precipice of Oblivion in Stormsong Valley.
Layson Eades is a human located in Layson & Sons Rigging in Stormsong Valley.
Laydia Vandersnatch was a human located east of the Ohn'iri Springs in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Lead Researcher Sytorian is a black dragon located in the Suphur Wastes in Zaralek Cavern.
Lee Brown is a human fishing trainer located on a pier on the north-western shore of Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest along with Jason Mathers. He can train players the skills of fishing.

Leftwitch is a gnome mage who lives in Kharanos. He hired Reclaimers Inc. to collect the following reagents from Desolace for his experiments: *ten horns and claws from the Hatefury satyr, *seven vials of scorpashi venom, *three hides from aged kodos, *ten felhound brains, *ten succubus wings, *and ten vials of doomguard blood. Adventurers helped Kreldig Ungor collect the reagents and then brought them in a package to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge so he could deliver them to Leftwitch.
Leeka Turner is a human found in her shop, Leeka's Shields & Maces, in Old Stratholme. She is also seen in The Deaths of Chromie.

Lee Olesky is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge. She is seen speaking with Kew Wyldheart.
Leedan Gustaf is a human located in the Ashvane Company Yards in Boralus.
Legion Commander Tyralion is a human located at the 7th Legion Front in the Dragonblight.
Legion Commander Yorik is a human located in the Wintergarde Mausoleum in the Dragonblight.
Leonard Porter is a human leatherworking vendor located at Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands.
Lemla Hopewing is a dwarf found in Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.
Lenaeas is a high elf tinker. He is a companion of Stefon the Loyal, Guzul'dar, and Tagradin.
Legionnaire Teena is an orc found in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar.
Leonard Schrick is a human located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Legionnaire Gutcrush is an orc located in Warspear. She sells Warlords Season 2 equipment.
Leoneras Sunrage is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Lenience's Reward is a Discipline priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Will of the Conclave and Tyranny of Pain traits.
Lena Shelvey is a human located at the Fallhaven in Drustvar.
Leo Shealds is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Legionnaire Voladis is a blood elf located in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar.
Lema Strongstout is a dwarf located in Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir.
Lenience is a Discipline priest talent that makes those affected by Atonement take 3% less damage. It is an exclusive choice node with Evangelism.

Lester Zank is a young high-ranking member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers, one of the four commodores. In Kul Tiras, young Lester served as a minor mage in Duke Falrevere's estate. The noble indulged the lad's interest in the dark arts out of respect for his father, who died in Falrevere's service when Lester was a baby. Others were not so kind, and shunned the pale, bald, fatherless boy. When the Scourge invaded Lordaeron, Lester traveled to the mainland, thinking to join the defense against the undead. The sight of the creatures horriﬁed him, however, and he lost his nerve. He found a secret basement and hid, surviving on preserved fruit while the Third War raged above. Finally, he emerged an
Leyan Steelson is a human located at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if he survived the Ironmarch.
Lexey Brevig is a human reagent and enchanting vendor located in Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.
Lethecus is a green dragon general goods vendor in the Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
Lessien is a blood elf tailoring vendor found at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.
Lewis Villamar is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Lessia Giantstrike is a human located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Librarian Serrah is a human member of Kirin Tor stationed in the Transitus Shield in the Borean Tundra. She will sell Frostberries and Frostberry Juice after her intro quest.
Librarian Erickson is a human and the enchanting supplier located at the Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Librarian Andersen is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Librarian Jeffers is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Librarian Ingram is a human inscription supplier located near the top of tower in Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Librarian Whitley is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Librarian Hamilton is a human herbalism supplier located at the Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Librarian Belleford is a human member of the Kirin Tor located at the Violet Stand in Crystalsong Forest.

Lieren is the tomboyish adopted human daughter of Kardan and twin sister of Loania. Together with her twin sister, they faced the horrors of Darkshire and Karazhan to put their parents' souls to rest.
Lien Farner is a human profession trainer located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Lidiya Peyton is a human found in Bizmo's Brawlpub underneath the Deeprun Tram.
Leza Farwalker (or Leza Dawnchaser) was a member of the Dawnchaser tribe and the wife of Sunwalker Dezco. The earth totem named Leza's Totem left behind after her death suggests she was a shaman.
Licefeaster is an orc innkeeper located at the Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Lieutenant Aldezoth is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Liana Goldthorn is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Lieutenant Akaro is an orc located in Ar'gorok in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. He wears the tabard of the Kor'kron.
Librarian Lightmorne is a human located in the Sanctum of Light.
Libergo is a blue dragon located in the Azure Archives Annex in Valdrakken.
Lhorek is a dwarf located in Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Lialyn Summersong is a blood elf located in Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.
Lieutenant Spencer was a human serving the Alliance in Alterac Valley. He guarded the Stonehearth Graveyard.
Lieutenant Largent was a level 59/69 elite human serving the Alliance in Alterac Valley. He guarded the Stonehearth Outpost, along with Lieutenant Greywand.
Lieutenant Lonadin was a level 59/69 elite night elf serving the Alliance in Alterac Valley. He patrolled between Icewing Bunker and Stonehearth Graveyard.

Lieutenant General Andorov is a human affiliated with Cenarion Circle who, along with 4 Kaldorei Elites, spawns once Kurinnaxx, the first boss found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, is dead. These NPCs will aid you in the battle against General Rajaxx. He was present for the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
Lieutenant Rotimer is a dwarf located in the Commons in Ironforge.

Lieutenant Benedict was a human found in Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. Daelin Proudmoore's former second in command, Benedict now ruled over the tiny parcel of land and led the remaining Kul Tiras sailors in Durotar. He and Watch Commander Zalaphil had been dispatched to retake the keep and guard it from the orcs who wish to finish tearing it down. Gar'Thok at Razor Hill is one such orc. Benedict's Chest contained an Aged Envelope which detailed orders from the deceased Admiral. He was there to finish what Daelin started, that is invade Durotar and kill all the orcs. Another Kul Tiras fleet was expected, namely that of Lieutenant Alverold who has not returned to this day. Naturally, the orcs di
Lieutenant Mancuso was a level 59/69 elite human serving the Alliance in Alterac Valley. He patrolled north of Stonehearth Bunker.

Lieutenant Valorcall is a human paladin based in the Arathi Highlands. He is the cavalry leader of Stromgarde. He once rode between Dabyrie's Farmstead and Stromgarde Keep, but after the Cataclysm, he only patrolled a little bit of the road south of Refuge Pointe. After midnight, however, he did his patrolling without his stead. He was once attacked in order to get the Sigil of Arathor and he barely escaped his death. Years later, he was attacked once more and presumably killed for the same thing.

Lieutenant Tomathren is a blood elf found in the Ghostlands, north of the Farstrider Enclave. He is found patrolling the campfire near Ranger Valanna. Tomathren was the leader of a poorly conceived attack on Zeb'Sora, and is not on the best of terms with her.
Lieutenant Khand is a human found at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown whether he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Lieutenant Ta'zinni is the leader of the mage hunters in the Lothalor Woodlands. He walks a circle around the Ley Line Focus. One Dragonblight Mage Hunter walks with him. Much like Captain Emmy Malin, Ta'zinni was forced into the service of Malygos under threat that harm would come to his family if he didn't. He is the brother of the mage trainer Deino, who formerly resided in Orgrimmar.

Timothy Clark is a human who originally hoped to become a guard for Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Since the Cataclysm, Timothy not only became a guard at Menethil Harbor but has also achieved the rank of Lieutenant.
Lieutenant Palliter is a human found on the top floor of Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. He is the commander of the Northwatch Expeditionary Force attempting to reclaim the keep.

Lieutenant Nath is a human guard in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It is unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the mana bomb.
Lieutenant Granders is an elite human aboard one of the warships docked at Theramore Isle during the Theramore's Fall scenario.
Lieutenant Worley is a human found at Honor's Stand within the Southern Barrens.
Lieutenant Corwin is a human located at Antonidas Memorial in Dalaran. He was called on by Jaina to help in the Purge of Dalaran.
Lieutenant Daniel is a human accompanying Mishka in Paw'don Village where he is helping her with injured Skyfire Marines.
Lieutenant Drak'on is an orc located in Battle on the High Seas scenario.
Lieutenant Parker is a night elf located in Battle on the High Seas scenario.

Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson is a human located at the Southern Isles in the Krasarang Wilds. He is a member of the Alliance army and is responsible for leading numerous ground assaults on the nearby Bilgewater lumber operation.
Lieutenant O'rok is a level 100 orc found in a small camp just north of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond.
Lieutenant Dilka is an orc located at the Orunai Coast in Talador.
Lieutenant Bruna is an orc located at the Anguish Point in . She and Lieutenant Drogg serve Malroc Stonesunder.
Lieutenant Drogg is an orc located at the Anguish Point in . He and Lieutenant Bruna serve Malroc Stonesunder.
Lifecycles is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Energizing Brew.
Lieutenant Velgroz is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Lieutenant Kol'zoth is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Lieutenant Garathok is a fel lord that attacks Kharanos in Dun Morogh during the Legion Invasions.
Lieutenant Arguzel is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Lieutenant Marakoz is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Lieutenant Warren is a human officer located on the Sword of Dawn prior to the battle for the Broken Shore.
Lieutenant Murray is a human officer located on the Sword of Dawn prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore.
Lieutenant Drelzekk is a fel lord attacking the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara during the Legion Invasions.
Lieutenant Koz'gorr is a fel lord located at the Legion Invasion locations.
Lieutenant Dakrazel is a fel lord that appears in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Lieutenant Gazrel is a fel lord that appeared at Legion Invasion locations.
Lieutenant Grezok is a fel lord that appears in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Lieutenant Vezeroth is a fel lord that appears in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Lieutenant Zar'teth is a fel lord that appears in various locations during the Legion Invasion.
Lieutenant Dorgen is a dwarf PvP Quartermaster. He is located in the Greyfang Enclave, Dalaran. He sells PvP consumables.
Lieutenant Xakaar is a fel lord located at the Felfire Armory in the Antoran Wastes. He is talking to a projection of Admiral Svirax.
Lieutenant Harris is a human located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Lieutenant Bauer is a human located at Seabreeze Landing in Stormsong Valley.

Lieutenant Oogra is an orc located at the Ruins of Auberdine in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. They were tasked with razing the remains of the town in order to deny use of them as a base to the Alliance.
Lieutenant Valen is a human located in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Lieutenant Silvermight is a night elf ghost located in the Apostate's Reach in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Lieutenant Samantha Redbane is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Lieutenant Cole is a human operating the Azerite Tank at the Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound. He was killed by Rexxar, Thomas Zelling, and the Horde adventurer when they invaded the estate.
Lieutenant Elsbeth Wavecutter is a human located at Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.
Lieutenant Wright is a human that appeared in Gilneas during early alpha.
Lieutenant Hawkins is a human located in Mezzamere in Nazjatar.
Lieutenant Vernon is a human located in Darkshire in Duskwood.
Lieutenant Hawlsey is a human located at Valgan's Field in Silverpine Forest. He supervises the training of new recruits. Calia Menethil asks to obtain his armor.
Light Brewing is a Brewmaster monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Training of Niuzao.
Lightning Paw is a rare fox spirit beast that appears in Duskwood. It can be found hiding in any sizable bush that shows blinking eyes.
Lightning Burst is a Windwalker monk artifact trait gained from Fists of the Heavens. This is a hidden trait that does not appear in either your spellbook or the artifact traits pane.
Light Ammo is a row 8 Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Heavy Ammo.

Linken is a gnome warrior with a mysterious past. He is a true warrior at heart, and unlike other gnomes has no interest in experiments or gadgets. He was originally located at Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro Crater, and adventurers had to help him recover his lost memories and uncover the reason he'd traveled to the crater. He disappeared from Un'Goro after the Cataclysm, but reappears in The Protectors of Hyjal and during the Great Gnomeregan Run.
Lina Hearthstove is a dwarf stable master located outside Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

Lindea Rabonne was a human fishing vendor located on the docks in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She was related to Donald Rabonne, who was standing next to her and was a Fishing Trainer. Lindea is nowhere to be seen after the destruction of Southshore.
Lindros was a passenger of the Horizon Scout, till it sank, he had business in Azshara, what exactly is still unknown.
Linna Bruder is a human tailoring vendor in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran who sells 5 different patterns.
Linda Ann Kastinglow is a human located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. She can provide directions to various locations in Dalaran.

Lilian Voss is a member of the Desolate Council and representative to the Forsaken within the Horde Council. Lilian was the daughter of High Priest Benedictus Voss, though she was killed at some point prior to the Cataclysm and was later uncovered from a coffin by an adventurer inside the Shadow Grave of Deathknell. Due in part to her history within the Scarlet Crusade, Lilian was horrified at what she had become after being raised into undeath by the Val'kyr. Initially rejecting life as part of the Forsaken, she began a single-minded campaign against the Crusade. The adventurer assists in killing her father and she later enlisted their aid after she had infiltrated the Scarlet Monastery as
Lilyn Darkriver is a night elf found at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.
Lindarel is a blood elf archaeology trainer located on the middle level (where the airship docks) of Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Lingering Apparition is a level 75 Unholy death knight talent.
Lilyiana Meadowblade is a night elf buried at Tel'anor in Suramar.
Lion's Landing Paladin is a dwarf located in Krasarang Wilds. They can be hired to accompany the player.
Lily Gilbreath is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Linda Deepwater is a human located in the Drust Bar in Drustvar.
Liliette Blackshield is a blood elf located in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley. She has golden eyes. She can be found dining with Kriana Lynnore.
Lightweaver is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Lightwell.
Lion's Landing Peasant is a human located in the Valley of the Four Winds during Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall II.
This is a list of keys that a player character may obtain in World of Warcraft. Many of these keys were lost with the removal of the keyring.
Lissan White is a human found at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord. She is the assistant to Chef Kettleblack but often skips work to daydream.
Lisa Philbrook is a level 70 human trade goods vendor located at Amberpine Lodge in the Grizzly Hills.
Lirastrasza is a red dragon using a high elf visage. She is involved in the Twilight Highlands storyline.
Little Liuyang is a fire spirit that appears as a boss during the Arena of Annihilation.
Lionel Rowe is a human located in Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound.
Lithe Apparition is a human located in the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
Lithragosa is a blue dragon located near the Rostrum of Transformation at Skytop Observatory in the Waking Shores, at Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains, and in Valdrakken.

Llane Beshere is a human warrior and warrior trainer located in Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He can be found on the ground floor of the abbey, in the third room on the right from entering the building - in the hall of arms. His is notable for teaching novice warriors the basics of combat. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Llane defended the remaining soldiers and the wounded near the entrance to the valley.
Logan Daniel is a human general goods vendor located at Odesyus' Landing in Azuremyst Isle.
Locheed was a dwarf trapped in the outhouse in eastern Searing Gorge.
Loania is the adopted human daughter of Voldana and twin sister of Lieren. Together with her twin sister, they faced the horrors of Darkshire and Karazhan to put their parents' souls to rest.
Logan Breezeboot is a Wildhammer dwarf trade goods vendor for Kirthaven in the Twilight Highlands.
Lleanya Mourningsong is a Darkfallen death knight located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Liyana is a human located at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

Locus-Walker (sometimes referred to as the Locus-Walker) was a void ethereal who taught Alleria Windrunner everything she knows about the Void. "Locus-Walker" is apparently not his real name, but it is all he has been called for now.

Livingston is a human who lived in Gilneas before the arrival of the Forsaken during the Cataclysm. He came up when he was mentioned by Lord Walden about his missing son. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Logarr is an orc located at the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor.
Liza Breezewood is a human located at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores.
Lokhtos Darkbargainer is a Dark Iron dwarf found in the Grim Guzzler, a tavern in Blackrock Depths.
Lohgan Eva is a human tailoring vendor located in Darkshire in Duskwood. He is the grandson of Madame Eva and brother of Alyssa Eva.
Lok was an orc located in Dalaran. She sold death knight glyphs.
Loguhn is the leader of the Snowfall Tribe of Wolvar found in the Dragonblight.
Longevity is a hunter talent located in the 4th tier of the Beast Mastery Tree.
Logistics Officer Silverstone is a human quartermaster located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Logistics Officer Brighton is a human Alliance Vanguard Quartermaster at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.
Loomee is an elite gorloc general goods vendor located at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.
Lok'nor Bloodfist is an orc Horde honor quartermaster found inside the Serpent's Spine Horde Tower on the Serpent's Spine.
Logistics Officer Renaldo is a human innkeeper located in Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens.
Logistics Officer Salista is a human innkeeper located in Fort Triumph in the Southern Barrens. Her status after the fall of Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.

Lone Wolf is a row 3 Marksmanship hunter talent. When the hunter doesn't have a pet summoned, this talent increases damage dealt and changes Command Pet into Fortitude of the Bear. Lone Wolf's damage bonus takes 20 seconds after the pet is dismissed to reach full effectiveness.
Logistician Wells is a human found next to the Command Table in Wrynn Artillery Tower at Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Lok'rig Felthrall is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Lone Survivor is a row 5 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Nature's Endurance.

Supreme Lord Kazzak is a battle-hardened doomlord and commander of Burning Legion forces. After the Third War, Lord Kazzak remained on Azeroth, in the Blasted Lands, and later reopened the Dark Portal, allowing the Legion to invade once more and marking the beginning of the invasion of Outland. Though Doom Lord Kazzak himself was defeated, he returned as Supreme Lord in the war in Draenor.
Lord Banehollow is a dreadlord of the Burning Legion and the former leader of Jaedenar, the seat of the Shadow Council on Azeroth.

Lord Shalzaru was a naga, and was the cruel royal leader of the Hatecrest. It is rumored that he himself has uncovered an odd relic during a recent naga excavation in a cave south of the main ruins, across the water on the Isle of Dread in Feralas. In Legion, Lord Shalzaru's Relic was discovered below the waves off the coast of Azsuna.
Lord Pythas (formerly known as Aryn) is an elite night elf found in the Wailing Caverns.
Lord Serpentis is a night elf located in the Wailing Caverns.
Lord Cobrahn (formerly known as Jarlaxla) is an elite night elf in the Wailing Caverns.

Lor'themar Theron (pronounced "LOHR-theh-mawr THEH-rohn") is the Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas and thus the ruler of the blood elves of Azeroth. He used to lead the sin'dorei in the absence of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider, but after his betrayal and eventual death, Lor'themar became the sole leader of his people. Lor'themar was once the second-in-command to Ranger General Sylvanas Windrunner, and assumed temporary leadership of the high elves after the Scourge onslaught, a role that would pave the way to his regency after the prince's return. After surviving the brutal Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas, Lor'themar, a former commander of the Farstriders, was entrusted with watching over the elven k
Lord Mayor Morrison is a human and leader of the Pyrewood Council who appears in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest during Pyrewood Ambush.

Lord Maldazzar is a rare mob human found near Malicia's Outpost in the Western Plaguelands. He can drop an Invader's Scourgestone, as well as a random item, and awards 50 reputation with the Argent Dawn.

Lord Marshal Raynor was a level 70 elite human of the Alliance who appeared at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands during the Dark Portal Opens event, specifically when the Dark Portal starts to be overrun by demons spawns. Raynor was accompanied by several level 65 Stormwind Marshals when summoned by Gnomeregan Conjurors.
Lord Irulon Trueblade is a human at Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.

Lord Del'theon was a night elf noble. He was one of many leaders killed during the fight against the Burning Legion. After his death, many of the nobles looked to Jarod Shadowsong as their leader on the battlefield.
Lord Agrovane is a human who bought Rehgar Earthfury as a gladiator from guards at an Alliance internment camp. Eventually, however, Rehgar was able to escape.

Loque'nahak is an extremely rare spirit beast found at various places in Sholazar Basin. He is the mate of Har'koa, the snow leopard loa of Zul'Drak. He respawns on a six to ten-hour timer. The Bronzebeard brothers spotted Loque'nahak near the Skyreach Pillar during their visit to Sholazar following the war against the Jailer. Before they could greet him, he faded back into the undergrowth.
Lord Jaraxxus is an eredar demon lord of the Burning Legion.
Loreli Fallglade is a night elf. It appears that she is a caretaker for the young, but is unable to have children herself.
Lord Kassarus is a naga lord located in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara.

Lord Mes is a forsaken death knight captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Mes or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.

Lorcan Flintedge is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Lorcan was present at the Stormwind Harbor during the preparation for the Alliance assault on the Broken Shore. He was on Captain Angelica's battleship, awaiting for the departure and offering a sip of his private stash to other adventurers. The liquid was very strong and drinking it would instantly make someone drunk. A relief bucket was near him for those needing to... purge the alcohol out of their body. He afterwards participated in the Battle for the Broken Shore. Considering he's one of the looks availables for the Weary-Eyed Mourners it seems he survive

Lord Selterus is a death knight located in the Town Hall of Lunarfall in . Selterus is one of several recruiting officers available to the hero. He offers the opportunity to exchange the default human guards for death knights. He is only available to players after constructing a level 3 Barracks.
Lord Etheldrin Ravencrest is the ghost of a male night elf located in Black Rook Hold. He is released after the defeat of the Amalgam of Souls.
Lord Perdition is a fel lord appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore, summoned by . Later he also appears in Azsuna.
Lorel Sagefeather is a night elf who, along with Tiris Rainshadow, seeks to restore balance to the wildlife of Whispering Bluffs and needs help with the corrupted vulture Gorebeak.

Lord Malgath is a fel orc encountered in the Assault on Violet Hold. During the first two stages of the dungeon, he periodically appears—floating above the ground and protected by a fel barrier—to open portals for Burning Legion forces. At the end of the first two stages, he opens a random prison cell containing one of the dungeon's bosses while also introducing the boss with a short description. At the end of the third stage, he lands in the center of the hold to personally attack the players. Upon his death, the final boss of the instance—either Fel Lord Betrug or Sael'orn—spawns.
Lord Vazuun is a fel lord located at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.

Lord Autumnvale is a human located in Autumnvale in Drustvar. He leads a cult called the Wickerites that is focused on worshipping a dormant wicker construct built by the Heartsbane Coven. When trying to sacrifice one of his cult members, Edwin Maldus, Lord Autumnvale was slain by the Alliance adventurer.
Lord Benedictus Norwington I was a Kul Tiran human who once owned the Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound. A statue dedicated to him can be found under a tree in the center of the estate grounds.

Private Lorelai Whetstone was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Fathomdasher, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Lord Kennings is a human located at Kennings Lodge in Tiragarde Sound.
Lord Malus is a fel lord that would have been located in Stormheim. He was building up forces in the harsh northern bluffs.
Lord Sinensus is a green dragon located at Cascade's Edge in Valdrakken. Together with his Assistant Tea Engineers, they are testing Bubble Poppy Tea and Sleepyvine Tea on Tea Testers.
Lord Andestrasz is a red dragon located in the Ruby Lifeshrine and Skytop Observatory in the Waking Shores and at Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Lord Joran Tremaind is a human located at Saldean's Farm in Westfall. He is a member of the House Tremaind, which deals in lumber in Eastvale, and is gradually taking over the affairs of his parents. As a young noble of the House of Nobles, he heard of the Breadbasket Guild and recently began to support them, in order to thank the people of Westfall who once helped his family start their business. He is also one of the nobles of Stormwind who are interested in the "​​House of the People" idea proposed by Countess Cecilia Clessington.

Loslor Rudge is a dwarf engineering vendor located in at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Loslor's engineering business supplies Hegnar Rumbleshot's gun business with ammo. Recently Loslor sent a courier up to Hegnar's camp and the courier decided to take a shortcut. While camping near the Grizzled Den, some wendigo chased off the courier. Needless to say, the courier didn't think to stop and grab up the shipment, and now Rudge wants it found and promptly delivered. If this were not the case, it would be terribly bad for business, seeing how Rumbleshot is quite an important customer.

Lorin Remka was the commander of one of the many internment camps where the orcs were held after the Second War. During the Second War, Remka disguised herself as a male to join the Alliance army so she could avenge the killing of her family and the sacking of her village. Her deception was discovered, and her commander placed her at the front lines hoping she would be killed (to spare himself the trouble of reporting her). She survived, however, and took great pleasure in killing orcs in combat — even going so far as to cover her face with their blood to mark her victory. Lothar is an officer in Theramore's army, most likely a colonel as he is mentioned by Duree as the one who should be sent to Northwatch to investigate recent events rather than Colonel Lorena.

Lorielyth is a member of the Brazilian Portuguese language CM team on WoW, Starcraft 2 and Diablo 3 Brazilian forums. She was the second Community Manager for Brazilian community. Lorielyth was already knew (by the name Lorie) because she got the blog WoW Girl. That Blog announced the leak of WoW's Brazilian-portuguese version. [http://us.battle.net/wow/pt/search?f=post&a=Lorielyth&sort=time Most Recent posts on Brazilian World of Warcraft forum]
Lorgrun Ironfist is an orc found north of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.

Lou is a human paladin who is a patron of the Hearthstone Inn. A Paladin with glorious hair, impressive muscles, and good humor. Beloved by all (he’s quite certain). Once an adventurer. Will he be one again?
Lucian Trias is a human bread and cheese vendor found inside One More Glass in Dalaran.

Lowan Featherbreeze is a Wildhammer dwarf located next to Father Gavin and Kelaan in Misty Pine Refuge in Dun Morogh. Judging by the short conversation the three are having, Featherbreeze and Kelaan appear to have been sent by someone to survey the damage done to Azeroth by the Cataclysm.
Ludin Farrow is a human dockmaster located at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He informs players of where the Northspear goes to in Northrend.

Lugrah is an orc jewelcrafting trainer found in the shop Red Canyon Mining & Jewelcrafting in the northeast section of the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. She can be found speaking with Marith Lazuria. Lugrah is also the jewelcrafting representative to the Artisan's Consortium. She sent Gnoklin Quirkcoil some of her notes.
Lucretia is a Mag'har orc food and drink vendor located at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.
Lucia Nightbane is a human paladin located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Lucretia Ainsworth is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Luma Nightjay is a night elf located at the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.

Lui Ka was a desert witch approached by the fight Di Chen who sought a true challenge. Amused by his arrogance, the witch gave him his wish: he would fight the desert itself. Each grain of sand became a fierce warrior intent on Di Chen's death. The battle would only end when Di Chen would admit that there were some challenges too difficult even for him. However it is said that Di Chen still fights to this day, showing that he has so far been able to do so.

Lulubelle Fizzlebang (or Lulu) is a gnome warlock member of the Council of the Black Harvest. She is the sister of Wilfred Fizzlebang, a famous gnome warlock who was killed by Lord Jaraxxus after he inadvertently summoned him during the Trial of the Crusader.
Luke Cutler is a human meat vendor located at Hook Point in Boralus.
Lumbering Leo is a human located in Highlands Mill in the Arathi Highlands.
Luma Noss is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Lug'ruk is an orc located in Ar'gorok in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.

Lukh Rockrunner is a young dwarf of the Dragonscale Expedition located in the Azure Span. He is an assistant of Branor Broadbraw and has a thing for flowers. While traveling to Three-Falls Lookout, he wanted to look around the forest but got caught by a Gloomfur Sasquatch. Branor asked an adventurer to find Lukh, and they did so in a cave. After killing the sasquatch, Lukh returned to Branor.
Lursa is an orc stable master located at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

Lumpo was a member of the Copper Street Gang. His master Skezzo would use him as a threat to blow up a shop that owed money. He later appeared to collect the money that Luzik Gallywix owed them but ended up being blown up by Jastor Gallywix who had placed dynamite instead of money in the bag.
Lurst Ragebreak is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Lylandris was a night elf Warsong Gulch battlemaster located in the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge. She only appeared during the Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch.
Lyesa Steelbrow is a dwarf tabard vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge.
Lyrai is a night elf general goods vendor located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Lyria Du Lac is a human warrior trainer located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. She can be found behind the blacksmith building.
Ma'ruk Wyrmscale is a rare mob orc found in the dwarven bunker in Dun Algaz near Wetlands.
Lynore Windstryke is a night elven rogue and a commander in the 7th Legion. She was one of the leaders of the Might of Kalimdor until it was disbanded.
Lyndsay Hollister is a human hunter trainer located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
Lynn Baxter is a human gun and alcohol vendor in Highbank of the Twilight Highlands.
Lyalia is the daughter of Lorekeeper Vaeldrin, and the commander of the Sentinel forces sent to Pandaria because of a vision Tyrande had.
Lys Ladimore was a human who was buried at the Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. She was the wife of Morgan Ladimore.
Lylnleath Featherfoot is a night elf beast master hunter located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Lyessa Bloomwatcher is a night elf who for over centuries watched over G'Hanir, the Mother Tree. During the third invasion, she was found at the Circle of Spirits in the Dreamgrove of the Emerald Dream, holding the Nightmare corruption back. After being aided by the Archdruid of the Dreamgrove, she left the Dream to return to Rensar Greathoof and Remulos. Naralex sensed her presence and sent the Archdruid to her in order to help them cleanse the corrupted G'Hanir. She then traveled to Nordrassil to Mount Hyjal only to find the well and the area severely damaged by the Burning Legion. Luzen was a blood elf in service to Illidan Stormrage and was close with Alesha. While it is unknown what happened to him, he may have died during the assault on the Black Temple.
Lynel'a is a night elf ghost located in Lunar Crucible in Suramar.
Lyanae is a blood elf located in Tirisfal Glades. She assists the adventurer during The Silver Hand (quest) alongside Helda the Breaker, Shieldbearer Anak, and Kelissa Stilwell.
Lydia Maldus is a human located at the Trader's Camp in Drustvar.
Lyssa Treewarden is a human located at Algerson Lumber Yard in Tiragarde Sound.
Ma'ra Grimfang is a Mag'har orc located in the Battle of Dazar'alor, along with Anathos Firecaller. On , she fought against goren and the Lightbound. She refers to herself as the dragon of Draenor.
Lydiara Whisperfeather is a night elf located at the Azure Archives in the Azure Span.
Lythe is a blood elf located at the Ruby Feast in Valdrakken.
